library_order.title.description: Settings > Libraries row and page title: the setting for the order of the favorite libraries on Home and in the Library header. Row label, short.

library_order.value_server.description: Trailing read-out of the Library order row when the profile has no saved order: the libraries stand in the order the servers list them. Short.

library_order.value_first.description: Trailing read-out of the Library order row when an order is in effect: the library shown first, then a word that says it comes first. {title} is a library name. Short; the row is narrow.

library_order.row_detail.value: Choose the order of your favorite libraries on Home and in the Library header.
library_order.row_detail.description: Sentence beside the Settings root while the Library order row has focus. One sentence naming where the order applies: Home and the Library page's header of library names.

library_order.reset.description: Button row at the end of the Library order page: it puts the favorite libraries back in the order the servers list them. Short imperative.

library_order.state_idle.value: Press OK to move {title} up or down. Home and the {kind} header show your favorite libraries in this order.
library_order.state_idle.description: Sentence on the Library order page while a library row has focus. {title} is the focused library's name; {kind} is the plural kind word (Movies or TV Shows) of the header it appears in.

library_order.state_reset.value: Puts your favorite libraries back in the order your servers list them.
library_order.state_reset.description: Sentence on the Library order page while the Reset Order row has focus.

library_order.state_moving.value: Moving {title}. Up and Down move it, OK puts it here, and Back puts it back.
library_order.state_moving.description: Sentence on the Library order page while a library has been picked up to be moved. Up and Down, OK and Back name the remote's buttons. {title} is the library's name.

library_order.state_unnamed.value: {title} can't be moved yet: its server hasn't finished connecting.
library_order.state_unnamed.description: Sentence on the Library order page while a library whose server has not finished connecting has focus: it cannot be moved yet, because the saved order names a library by its server. {title} is the library's name.

library_order.state_dropped.value: {title} is now {home} on Home and {header} in the {kind} header.
library_order.state_dropped.description: Sentence on the Library order page right after a library was put down. {home} and {header} are ordinals from the ordinal.* words (first, second, ... or number 11); {kind} is the plural kind word (Movies or TV Shows).

library_order.state_confirm.value: Press OK again to put your favorite libraries back in the order your servers list them. Any other button keeps your order.
library_order.state_confirm.description: Sentence on the Library order page after OK on Reset Order: the second OK resets, any other button cancels.

library_order.state_reset_done.value: Your favorite libraries are back in the order your servers list them.
library_order.state_reset_done.description: Sentence on the Library order page right after the order was reset.

library_order.state_unsaved.value: Couldn't save this order; it applies until PlxNative restarts.
library_order.state_unsaved.description: Sentence added on the Library order page when the order could not be written to disk: it still applies, but only until the app restarts.

library_order.preview_caption.description: Small caps caption over the preview of the Library page's header of library names. {kind} is the plural kind word (Movies or TV Shows); the dot separates it from the words Library header.

library_order.preview_more.value: Libraries that don't fit go behind ….
library_order.preview_more.description: Caption under the header preview, shown only when the real Library header would not hold every library of the kind: the ones that do not fit are in the menu opened by the three-dots button. Keep the … character.
